name: deployer-onboarding
description: Open Atlas Deployer onboarding assessor: reads a repository in an isolated sandbox, assesses whether and how the Deployer can deploy it, and configures the assessment's draft through the Deployer's draft tools with a task token.

credential_requirements.description: The Deployer's read-only service key (dps_), stored for the MCP URL above; draft writes also need the task token from the first message.
Read-only tokens for private git hosts (company Bitbucket, allowed GitHub organisations), stored per host.
